FLEETCOMMANDER

You don't fly the drones. You design the forces, rules and information that make a swarm fly itself.

How to play
  • Select: drag a box, or click a drone to grab its squad. Shift adds. Double-click selects that role on screen.
  • Order: right-click to move. Right-click an enemy to attack. Keys: A attack-move, P pincer, T patrol, O orbit, then click; H hold, R retreat, F cycle formation.
  • Groups: Ctrl+1–9 to assign, 1–9 to recall (twice to jump the camera).
  • Economy: build Extractors on gold wells for energy. Relay Towers add command bandwidth (your unit cap) and extend where you can build.
  • Fly a drone: select drones and press Enter. Left stick: W/S throttle (climb/sink), A/D yaw (turn the nose). Right stick: I/K or ↑/↓ pitch (tilt forward/back), J/L or ←/→ roll (tilt sideways). Space/click fires at what your nose points at, Tab FPV/chase camera, Enter hands control back. A gamepad works too (Mode 2). If your drone goes down you jump into the nearest squadmate.
  • Scripts: press G (or the Script button) to give a squad reaction rules — it fights for itself.
  • Camera: arrow keys, screen edges or right-drag to pan, wheel to zoom, Q/E or middle-drag to rotate, Space jumps to the last alert, Home to your core.
  • Build: Z extractor · X relay · C fabricator · V radar · B jammer · N kill zone · M repair. Produce: Shift+1–6.
  • Counters: interceptors shred scouts and support · scout swarms sting assault · assault breaks interceptors and buildings.
